Planned availability differs by feature and target audience:

- **Advanced OCR Pipeline**: Scheduled for general release in August 2026 (v2.8.0, target August 25, 2026) as a standard component of the KnowledgeHub ingestion layer [NL-014#NL-014-S03][NL-014#NL-014-S06]. Plan availability: included natively in the Enterprise plan, offered as a paid add-on for Growth plans ($500/month), and **not** supported on the Starter plan [NL-014#NL-014-S06].

- **WorkflowCoach Public Beta**: Target release is September 2026 (v2.9.0, target September 29, 2026), available to all active Growth and Enterprise accounts [NL-014#NL-014-S03][NL-014#NL-014-S05]. It is currently in a private/internal beta for about 11% of active customers [NL-014#NL-014-S05][NL-002#NL-002-S07]. However, engineering leadership indicates the September date is at risk, with a realistic slip to November 2026 due to dependencies on the Advanced OCR Pipeline, permission synchronization, and state-management/permission issues [NL-014#NL-014-S05][NL-015#NL-015-S05]. An internal contingency plan anticipates a possible November public launch [NL-015#NL-015-S05].

- **Teams connector**: Planned for Q4 2026 (v2.11.0, November release), currently under active design and planning [NL-014#NL-014-S07]. A restricted pilot begins October 2026 with selected financial and healthcare enterprise accounts to validate security isolation before general release [NL-014#NL-014-S07]. It depends on Microsoft Graph APIs, which creates third-party risk [NL-014#NL-014-S09]. It is not generally available; only the Slack connector is currently available as a limited pilot [NL-014#NL-014-S07].

In summary, Advanced OCR is the earliest planned release (August 2026) with tier-specific availability, WorkflowCoach public beta targets September 2026 but may slip to November 2026 for all Growth/Enterprise accounts, and the Teams connector is the latest (November 2026) with only a restricted October 2026 pilot.
